lionel_exchange.summary_zh: 整合多交易所市場資料的個人加密資產分析工具，聚焦在即時行情觀測、K 線視覺化與套利機會探索，讓研究流程可以從資料蒐集一路延伸到策略驗證。
lionel_exchange.summary_en: A personal crypto market analysis tool that aggregates data across exchanges, focusing on live market tracking, candlestick visualization, and arbitrage exploration from research to validation.
features_zh: 整合多個交易所資料來源，統一成同一套前端顯示模型
提供 K 線圖與市場走勢視覺化，方便快速切換觀察區間
針對價差變化設計套利觀測流程，協助快速識別機會
將資料查詢與畫面呈現拆分，降低後續功能擴充成本
features_en: Aggregates multiple exchange data sources into a single frontend view model
Provides candlestick charts and market trend visualization with fast range switching
Designs an arbitrage monitoring flow to surface spread opportunities quickly
Separates data querying from presentation logic to keep future extensions manageable
achievements_zh: 建立可持續擴充的市場資料整合基礎
把資料探索流程收斂成可視化操作介面
降低手動比對多交易所行情的成本
achievements_en: Built an extensible foundation for aggregated market data analysis
Turned manual market exploration into a visual workflow
Reduced the cost of comparing prices across exchanges

charlie-ai-protocols.summary_zh: 工業級 AI 多代理協作框架與 CLI 工具。定義 17 位專職 AI Agent 的角色邊界、交接協議與品質門禁，搭配 CrewAI 執行引擎、Shell CLI（cap）與雙寫 Trace 機制，讓 AI 與工程團隊在同一套契約下穩定協作。
charlie-ai-protocols.summary_en: An industrial-grade multi-agent AI collaboration framework and CLI tool. Defines role boundaries, handoff protocols, and quality gates for 17 specialized AI agents, backed by a CrewAI engine, Shell CLI (cap), and dual-write tracing — enabling AI and engineering teams to work under a unified contract.
features_zh: 17 位專職 AI Agent：PM / Tech Lead / BA / DBA / UI / Frontend / Backend / DevOps / QA / Security / SRE / Analytics / Troubleshoot / Figma Sync / Logger / Watcher / README
全域憲法 (00-core-protocol.md) 統一所有 Agent 的行為準則、溝通語言與自檢迴圈
三消費者架構：同一份 SSOT 同時供 CrewAI (factory.py)、Claude Code (@import)、Codex ($prefix) 使用
Shell CLI 工具 (cap)：一鍵安裝 (curl | bash)、版本管理 (update / rollback)、Agent 調用與 session tracing
BYOCLI 模式：在任何 AI CLI 中以 $prefix 臨時調用單一 Agent（如 $qa、$security、$frontend）
雙寫 Trace 機制：純文字 (.log) + 結構化 (.jsonl) 同步寫入，支援人讀與機器消費
10 套框架與工具策略：Angular / Next.js / Nuxt.js / .NET / NestJS / Playwright / k6 / Lighthouse / Unit Test
品質門禁流水線：Watcher 結構稽核 → Security 資安審查 → QA 行為驗證，全數 PASS 才准予結案
README 治理系統 (101-readme-agent)：情境式路由自動判定 rewrite / normalize / manifest_plus_readme
Promote 工作流：本機 drafts / reports 升級至 repo 正式路徑 (cap promote)
features_en: 17 specialized AI agents: PM / Tech Lead / BA / DBA / UI / Frontend / Backend / DevOps / QA / Security / SRE / Analytics / Troubleshoot / Figma Sync / Logger / Watcher / README
Global constitution (00-core-protocol.md) unifying behavior rules, communication language, and self-check loops for all agents
Three-consumer architecture: single SSOT consumed by CrewAI (factory.py), Claude Code (@import), and Codex ($prefix)
Shell CLI tool (cap): one-click install (curl | bash), version management (update / rollback), agent invocation, and session tracing
BYOCLI mode: invoke any agent via $prefix in any AI CLI (e.g., $qa, $security, $frontend)
Dual-write tracing: plain text (.log) + structured (.jsonl) written simultaneously for human and machine consumption
10 framework and tool strategies: Angular / Next.js / Nuxt.js / .NET / NestJS / Playwright / k6 / Lighthouse / Unit Test
Quality gate pipeline: Watcher audit → Security scan → QA verification — all must PASS before closure
README governance (101-readme-agent): scenario-based routing for rewrite / normalize / manifest_plus_readme
Promote workflow: local drafts and reports elevated to repo-level paths (cap promote)
achievements_zh: 將 17 角色的 AI 協作流程制度化為可版控、可安裝、可跨 repo 復用的標準規範
實現三消費者架構，單一 SSOT 同時餵給 CrewAI / Claude Code / Codex 三端，消除多份口徑
建立完整 CLI 工具鏈 (cap)，從安裝、同步、調用、tracing 到版本管理一條龍
設計品質門禁三道閘：結構稽核 (Watcher) → 資安審查 (Security) → 行為驗證 (QA)，確保交付品質
沉澱 10 套框架策略，涵蓋前端 (Angular/Next.js/Nuxt.js)、後端 (.NET/NestJS) 與測試 (Playwright/k6/Lighthouse) 全棧
achievements_en: Codified 17-role AI collaboration into a version-controlled, installable, cross-repo reusable standard
Implemented three-consumer architecture where a single SSOT feeds CrewAI, Claude Code, and Codex simultaneously
Built a complete CLI toolchain (cap) covering install, sync, invocation, tracing, and release management
Designed a three-gate quality pipeline: structural audit (Watcher) → security scan → behavioral verification (QA)
Distilled 10 framework strategies spanning frontend (Angular/Next.js/Nuxt.js), backend (.NET/NestJS), and testing (Playwright/k6/Lighthouse)

financial-agent-frontend.summary_zh: 面向投資研究情境的 AI Agent 前端介面，將對話式操作、財務資訊視覺化與多資產監看整合在同一個工作台中，強調研究效率與資訊密度的平衡。
financial-agent-frontend.summary_en: An AI agent frontend for investment research that combines conversational workflows, financial visualizations, and multi-asset monitoring in a single workspace with a strong focus on research efficiency.
features_zh: 整合對話式研究操作與多面板資訊瀏覽
以視覺化方式呈現財務與市場資料，降低閱讀負擔
支援多資產監看情境，讓研究上下文能集中在同一頁面
透過模組化區塊設計保留後續擴充彈性
features_en: Combines conversational research workflows with multi-panel information browsing
Visualizes financial and market data to reduce reading overhead
Supports multi-asset monitoring so research context stays in one place
Uses modular sections to preserve future extensibility
achievements_zh: 建立投資研究導向的前端資訊架構
把 AI 對話與金融資料視圖整合到同一個使用流程
為後續 Agent 能力擴充預留清楚的 UI 分層
achievements_en: Built a frontend information architecture tailored to investment research
Integrated AI conversation and financial data views into one workflow
Prepared a clear UI layering model for future agent capabilities
